name: Mechs vs Minions

categories.label: Mission won
categories.hint: Each Mission dossier sets its own win condition; any Mission is lost if the Bomb explodes or the Boss reaches 3-Power and fires

winCondition: Cooperative missions: win condition is defined per Mission Dossier (e.g. drain the Doom Tracker to zero for the Boss, or reach the objective). Lose if the Bomb explodes or a Boss Command Line slot executes at 3-Power.

endCondition.description: Per-mission objective; defeat on Bomb explosion or Boss 3-Power slot executing

notes: family: coop. No points. Mission-specific win conditions are not modelled; scorer records win/lose and mission number. Source is a rules summary, not the official PDF.
